name: Vampire - Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only) - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a attack

results.text: Your fangs glisten in the moonlight as you lunge with predatory precision.
The air chills as your shadow stretches, hunger driving your lethal embrace.
A whisper of bat wings precedes your strike, claws unsheathed for the kill.
Eyes like crimson embers lock onto flesh, your thirst demanding satisfaction.
Dark tendrils writhe from your form as you close in for the fatal bite.
